question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Verify the matches
WITH ent_top_styles AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, StyleStrength,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) as rnk
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
ent_top2 AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_style
    FROM ent_top_styles
    WHERE rnk <= 2
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING first_style IS NOT NULL AND second_style IS NOT NULL
),
cust_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING first_pref IS NOT NULL AND second_pref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName, et.first_style, et.second_style, cp.first_pref, cp.second_pref
FROM ent_top2 et
JOIN cust_prefs cp ON (
    (cp.first_pref = et.first_style AND cp.second_pref = et.second_style)
    OR (cp.first_pref = et.second_style AND cp.second_pref = et.first_style)
)
JOIN Entertainers e ON e.EntertainerID = et.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
